coverage.radiocarbon: Only the accessible tables and observations specified here were recovered. A blank list does not establish absence of radiocarbon work at the site.

published_sequence_crosswalk.text: The first report uses I (Early), II (Transitional) and III (Mature). The revised sequence separates IA and IB from the earliest occupation and relabels Transitional II as IIA and Mature III as IIB.
